inputs_definition.default: A rugged Wild West thief: a wiry outlaw with sharp, cunning eyes and a weathered, sun-beaten face shadowed by a wide-brimmed cowboy hat. He wears a dusty bandana pulled up over his nose, a worn leather duster coat, fingerless gloves, and a gun belt slung low with a holstered revolver. His clothes are patched and trail-worn, boots caked in desert dust. He carries a small bulging sack of stolen loot slung over one shoulder, standing tense and alert in a dusty frontier town at dusk, ready to bolt at the first sign of trouble.
